what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Maya Dotan's seven identity layers for AI agents, and how our agent teams answer each one.
sections.para: A name, a key per session, a For: line, a behaviour policy, decisions as pages, and a signed record.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Her map, naming, keys, authority as policy, reputation as a record.

sections.label: Her map
sections.line: 190 projects from 81 organisations; authority has the most work, naming and reputation the least.
sections.para: She asked for missing projects; ours answers every row.

sections.label: Discovery and naming
sections.line: A dotted address says what the agent is, which team, and for whom: place.olhao@PrompTugal.dinis.
sections.para: The cheapest layer with the biggest return.

sections.label: Authentication and agent identity
sections.line: Each session makes a P-256 key; 147 entries in the registry, 98 active, 49 superseded.
sections.para: Identity is name, current key and policy together.

sections.label: Who it acts for
sections.line: The name ends with the person, and every commit says For: whom; only the person instructs.
sections.para: Other people's agents work under an external policy.

sections.label: Authority and limits
sections.line: An Agent Behaviour Policy per role, 45 roles in one file, kept by hooks on every tool call.
sections.para: Some limits sit above the agents; the rest were observed, with a circuit breaker.

sections.label: Intent and approval
sections.line: Decisions are pages, asks wait in a status file, irreversible acts stay drafts, only the person merges.
sections.para: Approval at altitude, not per action.

sections.label: Reputation
sections.line: Reputation as a signed record: 2,032 run reports, hourly reports, reviews and daily debriefs.
sections.para: Trust becomes a question you can answer from evidence.

sections.label: What this adds to her map
sections.line: Plain keys and files suffice; naming and reputation are by-products; enforcement is the hard part.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Inside teams we run; mostly observed, not blocked; session keys by design; her counts are hers.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Maya Dotan's post, the PrompTugal.news repository files, abp.sgit.ai and earlier articles.
